race.comment: YOU NEVER CAN TELL (4) was first up off a short break here over 1200m and proved too good, scoring by just under a length. He should be even better suited rising to 1400m off that and with any luck from the wide gate he should take beating. KING MAYWIN (3) was in the market over this route last time in a BM62 but struggled after drawing wide and pushing forward. The maiden win prior was dominant and he can bounce back strongly. QUBELLA (9) won nicely here two back over 1200m and is racing quite well for an 8yo mare. She'll take some holding out. ACHETER (10) switches to synthetic for the first time which could spark improvement.
